description: Read-only input passed from a parent component to a child.
Compiler macro of `<script setup>` that declares props, either with a runtime object or a TypeScript type.
Vue 3.5 feature: `const { a = 1 } = defineProps()` keeps reactivity because the compiler rewrites `a` to `props.a`.
A `boolean` prop written without a value (`<Comp online />`) is `true`; when absent it is `false`.
Data flows from parent to child through props; children request changes with events.
